description.en: Registers a character handle as a "talker" bound to a message-text key (typically a "pname_<baseID>" name-placeholder key), so subsequent CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN dialogue can resolve that key to the character (for portrait/name-plate display, name substitution, etc.).
Character handle to register as a talker.
Message-text key associated with this character, e.g. "pname_0035".
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).
